question: Our password reset and receipt emails go out through a box we run ourselves and too many of them land in spam. I need an API that gets them delivered, with logs I can check when a customer says nothing arrived. Node, maybe fifty thousand emails a month. Which provider would you use, and what else did you look at first?
summary: Resend already documents API-key creation in its CLI. The partial scan result is not a reason to build another provisioning interface. The useful next test is sending and diagnosing a transactional email after access is granted.

items.title: Verify the first send, including delivery evidence
items.finding: The scan found only one provisioning phrase. The CLI already documents creating API keys; its initial login takes an existing key. Those are different steps, and the score does not establish a missing API.
items.nextStep: Give the agent an authorized test key and verified sender. Ask it to send a password reset and receipt to controlled recipients, then locate the request and delivery evidence.
items.validation: Record the initial account handoff, API responses, message identifiers and delivery status separately. An accepted request is not proof of inbox placement.

sources.note: Node SDK sending guide requires an API key and verified domain.
CLI authenticates with an existing key, can create further keys, send emails and retrieve logs.
